title: USF says it has deployed $1.054bn in contracted subsidies; 158 of 185 projects done
summary: Symposium in Islamabad focused on fibre, satellite, affordable smartphones and AI in rural areas.
benefit: Confirms USF as Jazz's steadiest public buyer; the rural focus now includes smartphones and AI, which opens bundles beyond coverage.

title: USF FY2026-27 budget of Rs32.90bn; 9 new NG-BSD and 4 NG-OFNS projects
summary: Rs6.56bn earmarked for new initiatives; 15 contracted 4G schemes target 3.66m people across 21 districts.
benefit: Thirteen new lots this fiscal year. Jazz won 5 USF lots in Jan–Feb 2026 and can reuse that pricing.

title: National Digital Masterplan advancing: governance, economy, society pillars
summary: Sector plans for health, education and commerce; unified patient records and a national clinical registry discussed.
benefit: Sovereign hosting, data platforms and citizen apps for sector plans; health registry is a large future hosting deal.

title: $200m ADB loan for FBR digitalisation recommended to ECNEC
summary: Includes upgrading 850TB storage to 3PB for video-camera monitoring of production lines in sugar, cement, tobacco and textiles.
benefit: Video storage, camera connectivity and analytics at factories: Garaj, IoT SIMs and Quantica in one bid.

title: Smart Islamabad: fusion centre, AI security system, new command and control centre
summary: Safe City, CDA and EPA data to be integrated into one platform. Safe City expansion holds Rs2,699m in PSDP 2026-27.
benefit: Islamabad is Jazz's home market: 5G backhaul, video hosting, IoT sensors and SOC for the fusion centre.

title: AI-powered traffic signals planned across Islamabad
summary: Part of the Safe City Expansion Project with CDA coordination.
benefit: Signals need M2M SIMs and a platform; e-challans can be collected through JazzCash.

title: Connected Punjab: $249m programme ($70m World Bank, $179m Punjab)
summary: Three parts: fixed broadband right-of-way and deployment support; shared GPU compute and AI citizen services; cashless economy with digital invoicing and e-payments. Implemented by PITB, PRA and PRMPU.
benefit: Touches three SBUs at once: fibre subsidies, GPU hosting on Garaj, and JazzCash for cashless payments.

title: ADB proposes $130m to digitise five DISCOs
summary: Concept cleared March 2026; fact-finding June 2026; digital technologies across distribution networks incl. PESCO and HAZECO.
benefit: Smart-meter connectivity at scale (M2M SIMs) plus a data platform; meet DISCOs before specs are written.

title: KP Promotion of Digital Payment Act 2026 approved
summary: Businesses, schools and hospitals must accept digital payments; all P2G payments moved to cashless from 1 Sep 2026; public Wi-Fi in markets.
benefit: Mandatory demand for QR acceptance and P2G gateways across 34 departments: JazzCash's largest legislated opening.

title: ADB BUILD: $400m facility for border upgrades and digital customs
summary: Up to $50m per project; Pakistan can apply across border posts from Aug 2026 to Aug 2033.
benefit: Border posts need connectivity, cameras and hosting; PLPA (Land Port Authority) is the likely client.

title: Sky47 Karakoram-01, an 8.5MW AI-ready sovereign cloud, opened in Islamabad
summary: Targets government, banking, telecom and healthcare workloads; a 5MW Karachi site is under construction.
benefit: Direct competitor to Garaj for sovereign workloads, or a capacity partner for GPU-heavy bids.

title: New Public Procurement Rules 2026; awareness sessions for agencies and vendors
summary: EPADS 2.0 is mandatory for federal procurement; agencies must still publish on EPMS.
benefit: Bid teams must be registered and trained on EPADS 2.0; the radar should watch both EPADS and EPMS.

title: National AI Policy 2025: AI fund, AI council, compute and AI cloud for institutions
summary: Targets 1m AI-trained professionals and 50,000 AI-enabled civic projects by 2030.
benefit: AI cloud for at least 100 institutions is a hosting market Garaj can address.

title: Pakistan seeks World Bank support on tokenisation and digital bonds
summary: 75 firms have applied for virtual asset licences under the Virtual Assets Act 2026.
benefit: Long-range: digital bond distribution and wallets could run through JazzCash.

title: National Data Governance Policy 2026: sensitive government data must stay in Pakistan
summary: Primary Data Registers, WASL data exchange, a Chief Data Officer in every public body; existing contracts holding government data to be updated within 12 months of the policy taking effect.
benefit: Localisation favours in-country hosts like Garaj; the 12-month contract refresh creates migration deals.

title: PSDP 2026-27 gives IT & Telecom Division Rs19.58bn (+20.7%)
summary: Rs5bn for IT initiatives, Rs3bn for USF and R&D Fund programmes, Rs500m for PSEB.
benefit: Sets the federal IT spending envelope for this fiscal year.

title: Proposed: $1bn National AI Ecosystem Development Program and Rs70bn Digital Infrastructure Connectivity Plan
summary: NAIEDP 2026–2031 with $100m sought for FY27; connectivity plan 2026–2030 with Rs5bn sought for FY27.
benefit: If funded, the largest AI-compute and connectivity pipelines in the country.

title: Sindh to set up a provincial data centre with NTC; PPP or NTC contract under review
summary: A committee will recommend the model within three months; P&D, IT department and NTC to draft the roadmap.
benefit: If it goes PPP, Garaj can bid for hosting, DR and connectivity; otherwise partner with NTC.

title: Sindh launches a unified e-portal for all government departments
summary: ADP scheme built with GCS Pvt Ltd for citizens, businesses and employees.
benefit: Portals need OTP/SMS, payments and hosting: add-on sale to the department and its developer.

title: NADRA Digital ID and Data Exchange Layer regulations; PDA building DPI sub-stacks
summary: New Digital ID Regulations 2025 and NDEL Regulations 2025; NADRA Procurement Regulations 2025 require competitive ICT buying.
benefit: Digital ID and data exchange are rails for JazzCash KYC and citizen journeys; NADRA buys security and infrastructure every year.
